title: HSK 3.9 · 合理, 配合, 调整, 宣传, 强大
focus: 追 · 集中 · 破 · 理由 · 刀 · 传 · 错误 · 整 · 朝 · 范围 · 空 · 左右 · 架 · 室 · 伟大 · 哈哈 · 理论 · 宣布 · 调 · 破坏 · 配 · 当地 · 大概 · 合 · 周围 · 布 · 重大 · 强大 · 合理 · 调整 · 宣传 · 大约 · 联合 · 组合 · 强烈 · 配合 · 结合 · 当中 · 坚强 · 合法
body:
This lesson is built around 合 *combine*: six words pair it with another character (联合, 组合, 配合, 结合, 合理, 合法). 大, 强, 调, 整, 宣 and 围 also return, so learning one word gives you a head start on its neighbours.

## Characters that repeat

| Character | Pinyin | Meaning | In this lesson |
|---|---|---|---|
| 合 | hé | combine, fit | 合, 合理, 联合, 组合, 配合, 结合, 合法 |
| 大 | dà | big | 伟大, 大概, 重大, 强大, 大约 |
| 强 | qiáng | strong (弓 bow) | 强大, 强烈, 坚强 |
| 理 | lǐ | reason, pattern (王 jade) | 理由, 理论, 合理 |
| 调 | diào / tiáo | tune; adjust (讠 speech) | 调, 调整 |
| 宣 | xuān | announce (宀 roof) | 宣布, 宣传 |
| 围 | wéi | surround (囗 enclosure) | 范围, 周围 |
| 当 | dāng | at, serve as | 当地, 当中 |

## Watch out

- 调 has two readings: **diào** (transfer, tune, 调查) and **tiáo** (adjust, 调整, 空调).
- 空 is **kōng** (empty, sky) but **kòng** in 空儿 / 有空 (free time).
- 朝 is **cháo** (towards, dynasty) but **zhāo** in 朝气 (morning).
- 传 is **chuán** (pass on); **zhuàn** only means "biography" (自传).

cards.Example: 狗在追猫。 gǒu zài zhuī māo: The dog is chasing the cat
cards.Notes: 辶 walking + 𠂤 duī (phonetic) = walk after someone, chase

cards.Example: 上课要集中。 shàngkè yào jízhōng: Concentrate in class
cards.Notes: 集 gather (birds 隹 on a tree 木) + 中 centre = gather to the centre, focus

cards.Example: 我的手机破了。 wǒ de shǒujī pò le: My phone is broken
cards.Notes: 石 stone + 皮 pí for the sound; stone splitting

cards.Example: 你有什么理由？ nǐ yǒu shénme lǐyóu: What's your reason?
cards.Notes: 理 reason, pattern + 由 from, cause = the cause behind it, a reason

cards.Example: 这把刀很快。 zhè bǎ dāo hěn kuài: This knife is sharp
cards.Notes: Pictograph of a blade. As a side radical it becomes 刂. Lookalike: 力 lì power

cards.Example: 把球传给我。 bǎ qiú chuán gěi wǒ: Pass me the ball
cards.Notes: 亻 person + 专 zhuān (phonetic) = person to person, hand on

cards.Example: 这是一个错误。 zhè shì yí ge cuòwù: This is a mistake
cards.Notes: 错 wrong + 误 error (讠 speech) = a wrong, a mistake

cards.Example: 我等了整整一天。 wǒ děng le zhěngzhěng yì tiān: I waited a whole day
cards.Notes: 敕 order + 正 zhèng straight (sound and meaning) = put in order, complete

cards.Example: 他朝我走来。 tā cháo wǒ zǒu lái: He walked towards me
cards.Notes: 𠦝 sun among grass + 月 moon = dawn (zhāo); "face towards" cháo

cards.Example: 范围太大了。 fànwéi tài dà le: The scope is too big
cards.Notes: 范 model, limit + 围 surround (囗 enclosure) = the boundary around, range

cards.Example: 你明天有空吗？ nǐ míngtiān yǒu kòng ma: Are you free tomorrow?
cards.Notes: 穴 cave, hole + 工 gōng for the sound = hollow, empty

cards.Example: 他三十岁左右。 tā sānshí suì zuǒyòu: He's about thirty
cards.Notes: 左 left + 右 right = give or take on either side, roughly. Lookalike: 左 has 工, 右 has 口

cards.Example: 书架上有很多书。 shūjià shang yǒu hěn duō shū: The shelf has many books
cards.Notes: 加 jiā add (phonetic) + 木 wood = wooden frame. Also 吵架 quarrel

cards.Example: 他在办公室。 tā zài bàngōngshì: He's in the office
cards.Notes: 宀 roof + 至 arrive = where you arrive under a roof, a room

cards.Example: 她是伟大的妈妈。 tā shì wěidà de māma: She's a great mother
cards.Notes: 伟 great (亻 person + 韦 wéi for the sound) + 大 big = grand

cards.Example: 哈哈，太好笑了！ hāhā, tài hǎoxiào le: Haha, so funny!
cards.Notes: 口 mouth + 合 hé for the sound, doubled = the sound of laughter

cards.Example: 理论和实际不一样。 lǐlùn hé shíjì bù yíyàng: Theory differs from practice
cards.Notes: 理 reason, principle + 论 discuss (讠 speech) = reasoned discussion, theory

cards.Example: 他宣布结婚了。 tā xuānbù jiéhūn le: He announced he got married
cards.Notes: 宣 proclaim (宀 roof + 亘) + 布 spread out = proclaim widely

cards.Example: 他被调到北京了。 tā bèi diào dào Běijīng le: He was transferred to Beijing
cards.Notes: 讠 speech + 周 zhōu for the sound = harmonize words, tune, adjust

cards.Example: 不要破坏东西。 búyào pòhuài dōngxi: Don't damage things
cards.Notes: 破 break + 坏 bad, ruined = break and ruin

cards.Example: 这两个颜色很配。 zhè liǎng ge yánsè hěn pèi: These two colours match
cards.Notes: 酉 wine jar + 己 = mixing wine, blending; match, pair. Watch 己/已

cards.Example: 我喜欢当地的菜。 wǒ xǐhuan dāngdì de cài: I like the local food
cards.Notes: 当 at, right there + 地 place = at this place, local

cards.Example: 他大概不来了。 tā dàgài bù lái le: He probably isn't coming
cards.Notes: 大 big + 概 general (木 + 既 jì sound) = the big picture, roughly

cards.Meaning: to close; to combine; to suit
cards.Example: 这双鞋很合脚。 zhè shuāng xié hěn hé jiǎo: These shoes fit well
cards.Notes: 亼 lid on 口 mouth/container = lid fits the box, close, combine

cards.Example: 周围很安静。 zhōuwéi hěn ānjìng: It's quiet around here
cards.Notes: 周 circuit, all round + 围 surround = all around

cards.Example: 这块布很软。 zhè kuài bù hěn ruǎn: This cloth is soft
cards.Notes: 巾 cloth + ナ (originally 父 fù, phonetic) = cloth; spread out like cloth

cards.Example: 这是重大的新闻。 zhè shì zhòngdà de xīnwén: This is major news
cards.Notes: 重 heavy + 大 big = weighty and big, major. 重 here is zhòng, not chóng

cards.Example: 这个国家很强大。 zhège guójiā hěn qiángdà: This country is powerful
cards.Notes: 强 strong (弓 bow + 虽) + 大 big = strong and big, powerful

cards.Example: 这个价格很合理。 zhège jiàgé hěn hélǐ: The price is reasonable
cards.Notes: 合 fit + 理 reason = fits reason, reasonable

cards.Example: 我要调整时间。 wǒ yào tiáozhěng shíjiān: I need to adjust the time
cards.Notes: 调 adjust (tiáo) + 整 put in order = adjust into order

cards.Example: 他们在宣传新电影。 tāmen zài xuānchuán xīn diànyǐng: They're promoting a new film
cards.Notes: 宣 proclaim + 传 pass on = proclaim and spread, publicize

cards.Example: 大约要一个小时。 dàyuē yào yí ge xiǎoshí: It takes about an hour
cards.Notes: 大 big + 约 approximate (纟 thread + 勺) = broadly, roughly

cards.Example: 我们联合起来吧。 wǒmen liánhé qǐlai ba: Let's join forces
cards.Notes: 联 connect (耳 ear + 关) + 合 combine = join together

cards.Example: 这个组合很好听。 zhège zǔhé hěn hǎotīng: This group sounds great
cards.Notes: 组 group (纟 thread + 且 qiě sound) + 合 combine = group together; also a band

cards.Example: 阳光很强烈。 yángguāng hěn qiángliè: The sunlight is intense
cards.Notes: 强 strong + 烈 fierce (灬 fire + 列 liè sound) = fiercely strong

cards.Example: 请你配合一下。 qǐng nǐ pèihé yíxià: Please cooperate
cards.Notes: 配 match + 合 fit together = match up with others, cooperate

cards.Example: 学习要结合实际。 xuéxí yào jiéhé shíjì: Link study to practice
cards.Notes: 结 tie a knot (纟 thread + 吉 jí sound) + 合 combine = tie together

cards.Example: 我们当中谁最高？ wǒmen dāngzhōng shéi zuì gāo: Who's tallest among us?
cards.Notes: 当 at + 中 middle = right in the middle, among

cards.Example: 她很坚强。 tā hěn jiānqiáng: She's very resilient
cards.Notes: 坚 firm, hard (土 earth at bottom) + 强 strong = tough, strong-willed

cards.Example: 这样做合法吗？ zhèyàng zuò héfǎ ma: Is this legal?
cards.Notes: 合 fit + 法 law (氵 water + 去) = fits the law, legal
